positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (IC7)
positions.description: AI-native systems for incident investigation, mitigation, and retrospection.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Led initiatives applying agentic AI and automation to enterprise support systems, improving case resolution efficiency and proactive issue prevention.

Designed a unified workflow platform consolidating multiple internal systems into a scalable abstraction layer.

Modernized data center alerting infrastructure, aligning with AWS high-availability, fault-tolerant distributed systems standards.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of Amazon Alerting and its evolution into customer-facing AWS services

Co-designed and launched AWS Incident Manager, a multi-region service for incident detection, engagement, and response

Built and scaled distributed systems for incident management, monitoring, and operational tooling across AWS global infrastructure

Contributed to system design, reliability engineering, and operational excellence practices across multiple teams

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led engineering of mission-critical incident engagement and on-call systems used by thousands of teams

Architected a multi-tenant, multi-region distributed alerting platform with 99.999% availability (five nines)

Owned system design, scalability, and resilience engineering for tier-zero services

Mentored engineers and promoted best practices in distributed system design and reliability

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed backend services for Kindle digital commerce, including purchasing workflows and promotion systems

Integrated across catalog, pricing, and publishing systems in a large-scale distributed environment

Built services for financial modeling and contribution calculations for digital ASINs on Amazon stores
positions.insights: Skills: Java · AWS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AngularJS · Perl

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to CMS and commerce platform architecture, focusing on front-end and platform frameworks

Built dynamic UI and personalization frameworks for enterprise content management systems

Developed server-driven UI systems powering editing and configuration experiences
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Dojo · jQuery · JavaScript

positions.title: Part-time System Developer
positions.description: Designed and delivered a full-stack web platform for security surveillance management systems
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · jQuery · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Modernized semiconductor manufacturing control software, focusing on system stability and compatibility

Worked on high-reliability systems in precision manufacturing environments
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · .NET · Standard Template Library (STL) · Real-time Control Systems

positions.title: Co Founder, CTO
positions.description:
Led engineering and product development for early-stage web platforms (e-commerce, search, community)

Defined technology strategy and built systems supporting high-traffic web applications
positions.insights: Skills: Web Services · E-Commerce · Software Architecture · Software Project Management · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed optimization algorithms for manufacturing planning systems

Built infrastructure for remote deployment, updates, and distributed operations
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Optimization · Algorithms · Network Security · Virtual Private Network (VPN)
